Transition.description: One exact receiving-owner transition, including its immutable proposal, local capsule generation, retained driver term and transition identity advance_id. The signed authority distinguishes an ordinary driver advance from native-owner settlement of already accepted work. Native-owner authority permits only the final adjacent phase transition with every required child succeeded and effects known; it grants no driver, child-admission or transfer authority and is never a workflow.advance transport input. requirements_digest is the canonical digest of this procedure's complete installed InstalledProcedureRequirements.const entry, never caller-selected semantics. from_phase and to_phase are consecutive installed phases. Retained accepted transitions keep these original bytes after later advances, owner observations or driver changes.

ChildOutcome.description: Complete owner-authenticated Operation for exactly this retained child slot and Plan. Every child whose start phase precedes to_phase appears once. The installed completion barrier requires succeeded with known effects and required result custody; a reviewed Plan or accepted/running/waiting receipt is insufficient there. Before that barrier, only accepted/running/waiting/succeeded with none or known effects can accompany positive native milestone evidence. Failed, cancelled, quarantined or unknown work blocks phase progress. A recovered completed slot preserves its exact original successful Operation and epoch, without reexecution or retargeting.

ParticipantEvidence.description: Exactly one proof per immutable participant owner/resource pair. Native evidence contains complete retained owner-held material proving this participant's obligations for the selected transition, including actual target identity, current resource generation and applicable exclusion, quiescence, fencing, candidate or result verification. Its owner equals this participant. The owner authenticates every Operation and verifies each required result's complete bytes under its action-owned schema before signing. The approval witness has state workflow-phase-verified, this owner epoch, resource_generation and workflow ID; evidence_digests is empty. Its subject_digest covers canonical {transition: PhaseEvidence.transition, participant: this complete ParticipantEvidence with witness omitted}. This binds actual child snapshots and native custody to the exact transition, not an unrelated digest or generic true assertion. The receiver independently authenticates the witness and obtains current native verification before supplying trusted phase evidence. A signature-shaped object or matching digest supplies neither. expires_at is selected by the issuing owner, is after witness.created_at, and is covered by subject_digest. Every new phase admission checks this deadline and independently revalidates current native exclusion and generation; unexpired signed bytes alone are insufficient. Accepted transition replay and historical inspection preserve expired original proof bytes without reauthorizing effects. Ordinary driver proofs are obtained through workflow.attest and immutable workflow.attestation.get/record.read, never synthesized by the driver. attestation_id is an issuer-owned immutable proof identity covered by this proof signature. For ordinary driver evidence it is the attestation request identity; for native-owner final settlement it identifies protected native observation custody and cannot be obtained by a driver claiming native authority. All resources from one issuer in a phase evidence closure use the same attestation_id. For ordinary driver evidence the receiver resolves that ID through workflow.attestation.get, reads the complete signed result, requires its complete local proof set to equal the submitted proofs, and independently invokes workflow.attestation.check; a caller cannot mix local resources from different issue snapshots. Native-owner final settlement obtains this complete proof set through workflow.native-attest using independently authenticated receiving-owner routing and rechecks the exact immutable record through workflow.native-attestation.check. The same attestation identity, complete local closure, pinned schema and signature joins apply; native peer authority is never supplied by the driver.

PhaseEvidence.description: Required complete evidence for one ordinary driver phase advance or separately recorded native-owner final settlement. Installed phase order is owned by states.json; native obligations and child completion barriers are owned once by InstalledProcedureRequirements.const in this schema. Every participant owner/resource appears exactly once, and every child started before the destination phase has its exact retained Operation. A participant without a child in that phase still proves its applicable generation, admission and custody obligations; silence does not remove it. Native owners retain required exclusions and fences through the corresponding effects, revalidate current evidence atomically with admission, and stop for reconciliation if they cannot maintain them. Evidence cannot authorize another Plan, release a hold, replace missing material or fabricate observed success. Native settlement preserves driver authority, incomplete transfer custody and holds; it cannot admit another child or advance an intermediate phase. Same-phase driver-transfer completion carries null phase_evidence and grants no procedure progress. Exact accepted transition replay uses retained evidence without requiring new signatures, observations or input custody; changed evidence or authority under the same transition identity conflicts. Pure schema and relationship checks do not authenticate owners, observe native state, establish freshness, pin content or qualify a native implementation. Aggregate qualification counts distinct participant owners and all receiving capsules, not only evidence growth at one issuer. With N owners each holding one participant, every receiving transition requires N distinct issuer proofs and its owner-bound transition changes each signed subject: one phase across all receivers requires at least N squared distinct subjects. The complete proposal is also retained at every owner. This full-closure composition does not establish the required aggregate linear bound; per-owner linear proofs cannot qualify it or authorize native release. Any aggregate implementation must preserve the complete authority, custody, replay and evidence joins while independently demonstrating the required bound over all recipients, retained bytes, phases and retries.

phases.draining: Resolve the complete affected live application scope from the reviewed host change and current owner state; close conflicting admission before draining. Every participant proves its current generation and retained recovery inputs.
phases.quiescent: Verify every affected application and writer has reached its required drained state, all draining children succeeded, and the exact host change is protected by continuing owner-enforced exclusion. An omitted or unreachable participant is not quiescent.
phases.host-effect: Revalidate the same complete quiescence and exclusion immediately before the reviewed host effect, including current host preimages and capture custody where required by the Plan. Retain those protections through the native outcome.
phases.reconciling: Verify the exact host-change child succeeded with known effects and current host or boot identity. Reconcile every affected application against its accepted release, permissions and recovery obligations before reopening admission.
phases.completed: Verify all reconciliation children and required application checks succeeded, account for the complete affected scope and retain all unresolved holds and recovery inputs. Completion alone does not release a hold.

phases.provider-verified: Verify the exact reviewed provider input, current owner/resource generations and typed interface scope before provider work; retain every declared consumer obligation.
phases.consumer-adopting: Require the exact provider child to have succeeded; independently verify its produced interface binding against the retained provider release and intended consumer configuration before any consumer adoption.
phases.consumer-verified: Require every selected consumer child to have succeeded and verify each accepted consumer release or secret generation uses the exact produced binding. A provider success does not establish consumer adoption or health.
phases.completed: Verify the complete provider/consumer closure remains coherent at the selected generations, including the required interface and consumer checks; retain explicit recovery obligations.

phases.candidate-validated: Validate the complete candidate route set against the approved ingress executor, scope, current generation and accepted binding obligations; retain its exact bytes without publishing it.
phases.published: Revalidate the exact candidate and expected generation under publication exclusion before the selected ingress publish child; no unrelated adapter method or scope can satisfy this role.
phases.reloaded: Require the exact publication child to have succeeded and verify installed route/configuration identity before the selected reload work. Retain the prior recovery basis and any required traffic exclusion.
phases.serving-verified: Require every reload child to have succeeded; verify the actual serving generation and complete routes under the approved ingress scope, including required upstream bindings and checks.
phases.completed: Verify the published, loaded and observed serving identities agree for the complete selected route set; account for retained prior-generation recovery and holds.

phases.participants-quiescent: Resolve the exact issuer, publisher and complete consumer set; enforce the rotation's required consumer quiescence or exclusion and pin accepted secret generations and recovery custody.
phases.issuer-changing: Revalidate continuing participant exclusion, current generations and the exact credential-issuer issue input immediately before the issuer child. No prior credential receipt can stand in for its future result.
phases.publishing: Require the exact issuer child to have succeeded with committed output; verify the real ciphertext derivation and later-reviewed publisher Plan through workflow.bind, preserving issuer identity and native credential custody.
phases.consumers-adopting: Require the exact publisher child to have succeeded with its complete retained receipt; verify publication of this issuer's candidate and exact predecessor before reviewing each consumer adoption.
phases.verifying: Require every selected consumer adoption child to have succeeded; verify each actual accepted consumer secret generation and required native checks against that exact publication receipt.
phases.completed: Verify the entire issuer/publication/consumer lineage and required consumer checks, with no omitted consumer or unresolved rotation effect. Retire old secret material only through its owning retention and recovery conditions.

phases.native-capturing: Resolve all preserved app-owned datasets, accepted release and secret generations from current accepted source. Establish the declared consistency scope and any required writer fence/capture cohort before native capture.
phases.sealed: Verify complete dataset capture receipts and immutable sealed checkpoint identity, including capture cohort or explicit independent-datasets consistency. The running backup Operation does not yet imply transferred or recoverable material.
phases.transferred: Verify exact sealed-object transfer, immutable backend identity and retained retrieval evidence for every required object; no incomplete or missing dataset may be omitted. Preserve native capture and secret/release custody.
phases.complete: Require the exact backup child to have succeeded with complete committed checkpoint result and declared retrieval custody. Verify every preserved dataset and selected release/secret closure. Capture success does not establish a restore drill.

phases.source-quiescing: Resolve current placement generation, exact destination and reviewed checkpoint or release recovery basis against accepted source; close conflicting production admission and account for every writer and externally owned dependency. The source app owner and exact target.destination host owner both independently approve this proposal and its local scope; the destination native-role participant proves current host admission and binding custody despite its empty child list.
phases.source-fenced: Positively verify complete source-writer cessation and durable fencing under the original placement identity. Timeout, disconnection or a changed owner epoch is not proof that the source stopped. The destination independently authenticates the source cessation and fencing proof and preserves its own isolation; neither owner may substitute its claim for the other owner native authority.
phases.destination-restoring: Maintain source fencing; verify destination isolation, approved resource bindings and exact retained recovery basis before restoration or declared reconstruction. A release basis cannot replace preserved data or waive external custody. The named destination host owner proves its exact host/resource generation and local isolation, approved binding and source-fence verification obligations through its own complete phase proof.
phases.destination-verifying: Verify complete restored or reconstructed dataset, release and secret identity in isolation, with the source still fenced. Required verification must not activate another production writer.
phases.placement-committing: Require positive destination verification and a current compare-and-swap of the exact reviewed placement generation while retaining source exclusion and recovery custody. The destination host owner independently approves the exact placement and local admission while the source app owner retains responsibility for the original accepted relocation child.
phases.activated: Verify committed destination ownership and actual production activation with the source still fenced. Establish that the same application has at most one admitted production writer. The destination host owner proves its actual production admission and preserved exclusion; its native evidence is mandatory although its operations collection is empty.
phases.completed: Require the exact relocation child to have succeeded; verify placement, destination checks, source fencing and complete data/secret/release custody. Completion does not authorize source data deletion.

phases.candidate-verified: Verify the complete retained source proposal, immutable repository identity, exact base/ref and candidate content under the approved source provider; source text cannot enroll a provider or authorize adoption.
phases.ref-updating: Revalidate the exact expected predecessor and candidate under provider-native compare-and-swap or equivalent exclusion before the selected source.publish child. A stale observation cannot authorize replacement.
phases.ref-verified: Require the exact source.publish child to have succeeded and verify the actual ref points to its complete candidate with the declared publication receipt and immutable repository identity.
phases.completed: Verify exact published ref/content and retained publication custody. Publication does not establish host or application adoption of that source.

phases.provider-observed: Observe the complete reviewed DNS changeset under the approved provider, zone and authority; verify exact current before-RRsets and generation with no silently omitted record or changed scope. Retain one complete stable observation traversal and its DNSGeneration, joining owner epoch, approved executor and native service incarnation exactly.
phases.applying: Revalidate exact before-RRsets and expected generation under native atomic prerequisites or equivalent exclusion immediately before the dns.reconcile child. Required semantics include TTL and complete RDATA membership. expected_generation is the exact observed DNSGeneration; changed owner, executor, incarnation or counter requires a new observation and reviewed change.
phases.verifying: Require the exact DNS child to have succeeded; verify authoritative after-RRsets, deletions and generation for the complete changeset under DNS set semantics, not merely adapter acceptance. served_generation retains the original owner/executor/incarnation namespace with a strictly newer counter; a digest or SOA serial cannot stand in for that identity.
phases.completed: Verify the complete requested authoritative state and retained provider evidence. Success does not assert unrelated recursive-cache propagation or erase recovery obligations.

phases.candidate-verified: Verify the exact complete immutable ciphertext candidate, catalogue, consumer/version identity and provider evidence against the approved publisher and selected predecessor; retain all bytes before replacement.
phases.replacing: Revalidate the exact expected predecessor under the publisher's native compare-and-swap or equivalent exclusion, current scoped authority and required recovery custody before the selected publication or recovery child.
phases.verifying: Require the exact publisher child to have succeeded with the completed retained receipt; verify current publication identity, ciphertext digest/size and exact predecessor against the selected candidate.
phases.completed: Verify the complete publication receipt and retained ciphertext/provider evidence closure. Publication does not establish consumer adoption or authorize old secret deletion.

phases.admission-closed: Resolve the exact reviewed task or approved adapter method to its actual controlling owner and mutation scope; close conflicting admission under current administrator authority and preserve accepted work and holds.
phases.quiescent: Positively verify all affected writers have stopped or reached the reviewed safe state, with complete controlling-owner exclusion and recovery inputs. A generic adapter name cannot bypass typed owner obligations.
phases.external-work: Revalidate continuing exclusion, exact task/method inputs, current generations and retained recovery basis immediately before external work; no caller-supplied command expands the reviewed scope.
phases.reconciling: Require the exact maintenance child to have succeeded with known effects; reconcile actual target state and all affected accepted resource bindings before reopening admission.
phases.completed: Verify the complete reviewed reconciliation and required checks, preserving every unresolved hold and recovery reference. External command exit alone is insufficient.

phases.draining: Resolve the exact management release, selected tools and owned durable-state closure; close conflicting tool admission and retain all accepted work, replay identities, holds and recovery inputs.
phases.checkpointed: Verify all required tool-state checkpoints and recovery custody after complete safe draining. State checkpoints are owner-owned tool recovery material, not fabricated application backup checkpoints.
phases.candidate-verified: Verify exact installed management artifact identity, platform capability and supported state migration paths against the retained source version and reviewed Plan before migration.
phases.migrating: Revalidate native exclusion and checkpoint custody before forward-only state migration. Preserve accepted outcomes and protected commitments across interruption; no destructive reinitialization or implicit downgrade is permitted.
phases.switched: Verify complete durable migration outcome and atomic selection of the reviewed tool release, with original state and accepted-work custody retained. Unknown migration effects block switch.
phases.verified: Verify the selected native release can open the migrated owner state and recover all required accepted work, exact replay identities and retained evidence under its installed schemas and permissions.
phases.completed: Require the exact host.runtime-install child to have succeeded and verify current release/state identity plus complete accepted-work and recovery continuity before restoring ordinary admission.

InstalledProcedureRequirements.description: The sole installed native phase obligations and child completion barriers for all v1 procedures. Every phase after prepared is covered; every admitted child start phase has a later completion barrier no later than the terminal phase. Phase order remains owned by states.json. This normative constant is part of the complete JSON Schema closure pinned by record delivery and independently installed historical readers; altering an obligation changes that identity. Requirements are never supplied or relaxed by a workflow proposal or phase-evidence caller.

UnsignedParticipantEvidence.description: Complete independently verified issuer-local participant context before owner-private signing. Never a public request or authority supplied by the driver. expires_at is chosen by protected receiving policy; native evidence and continuing exclusions are committed before acknowledgment.

AttestationRequest.description: Request the receiving participant owner to consider issuing its complete local proof for this exact driver transition. expected_generation selects the issuer capsule; transition.expected_generation selects the independently authenticated receiving capsule, which may belong to another participant owner. The issuer independently fetches current receiver context, authenticates the actual principal, checks current scoped read permission before any lookup, and checks current driver, scoped attestation permission and native authority for new issuance. All local participant resources are included, never a caller-selected subset. The issuer verifies current generations, installed requirements, exact successful child/result custody and continuing fences or exclusion before signing with its protected private key. The request supplies no proof, actor, key, native authority or expiry. Issuance does not increment a workflow generation or admit a child/phase transition; an owner can therefore attest its own pending transition without invalidating it. Issuer capsule phase is the requested from_phase or its immediate to_phase, permitting sequentially advanced peers to supply current evidence while forbidding skipped-phase evidence. The target receiver must still be at the exact from_phase/generation. Accepted identity is unique for the owner epoch. Atomically retain exact request, original principal, signed complete result and required native material before acknowledgment. Exact replay checks current read scope first and returns the original immutable result before new-generation, driver, lifecycle, deadline or native checks; changed input is CONFLICT. Required native protection that is unavailable or lost refuses new issuance and never produces an approval. A lost reply is acceptance uncertainty; retry this exact request or retrieve its immutable result with workflow.attestation.get. New native admission independently rechecks proof expiry and current protection; replay of an attestation supplies no renewed protection or authority. The owner epoch never frees an accepted attestation ID for reuse: proof expiry and release of releasable native material preserve the original result and changed-payload rejection. Native stores retain reservations and evidence for their required custody lifetime; capacity may refuse new requests without evicting accepted identities. This bounded request contains no complete collection.

AttestationLookup.description: Retrieve the exact immutable original attestation under current protected workflow and local participant read permission. Missing identity or another workflow is NOT_FOUND; another owner epoch is OWNER_EPOCH_CHANGED. Lookup never renews expiry, changes attribution or reacquires exclusion. The bounded reply is a WorkflowPhaseAttestation RecordReference; every record.read independently rechecks its complete protected disclosure scope. Expired proofs remain inspectable and cannot authorize fresh admission.

WorkflowPhaseAttestation.description: Complete immutable issuer-local attestation result. id equals request.attestation_id; owner equals request.owner, resource identifies request.workflow_id, and generation equals request.expected_generation without changing the capsule. request_digest commits the complete request. Each proof belongs to this issuer, covers a distinct local proposal participant resource and binds request.transition exactly; witness.created_at equals issued_at and its signed expires_at equals this record deadline. The original authenticated principal is retained. All local resources and complete native evidence appear, without a collection cap. workflow.attest and workflow.attestation.get always return a bounded RecordReference for these canonical bytes; record.read streams the complete exact result. Driver assembly requires one authentic current proof per proposal participant, exact transition equality, and independently trusted owner/key bindings; it supplies no native authorization. A restarted native journal restores exact requests/results and reservations, independently of workflow capsule generation. A restored owner epoch cannot reissue or reinterpret old proofs as current authority; historical records remain attributable to their original issuer. Durable custody includes the original RecordReference, its pinned schema closure and canonical payload bytes. Restoration preserves the complete reference exactly; it never rebinds an accepted identity to a newly installed schema closure. If its original closure differs, an independently installed qualified historical reader is required; missing reader or bytes fails restoration without rewriting accepted evidence. Native final settlement proofs are issued only by workflow.native-attest under independently authenticated receiver-owner context; their request authority cannot be used by the driver route. Both issuance routes and workflow.attestation.get return the same bounded immutable record delivery, and native assembly and current checks preserve the complete exact issuer-local proof set.

AttestationReference.description: Always-bounded immutable delivery of the complete attestation, including oversized local participant and native-evidence collections. Verify every chunk and the complete pinned schema/digest before assembling phase evidence.

AttestationCheckRequest.description: Ask the independently authenticated issuer to check this exact retained proof under current complete read scope and current driver/native authority. The issuer revalidates the exact target receiver Transition and its retained local native facts, material and continuing exclusion, including expiry and local/receiver generations. Missing protection or stale context refuses explicitly. This check never issues another attestation, renews its deadline, acquires authority, releases protection or mutates the original bytes. Native receivers make this call through independently enrolled peer routing before supplying trusted current phase evidence; a driver-supplied check result is not trusted context.

CurrentAttestation.description: Finite result of the issuer's current check of this exact immutable attestation and exact transition. Its original digest, signed expiry and proof bytes remain unchanged. Independently authenticated transport establishes who answered; schema validity or caller-supplied copies do not. checked_at is the issuer's current observation time, never a renewed lease or permission across a later race. The receiving owner still independently serializes new admission with the native protections required by the installed procedure and rejects if they cannot be maintained. Expiry never releases a hold or fence; native owners retain protection through the effects and explicit owning release conditions. Accepted transition replay uses original evidence without requesting new verification.

NativeAttestationRequest.description: Protected owner-to-owner request for complete issuer-local evidence of the receiver's final adjacent native settlement only. The issuing process independently authenticates an enrolled peer owner epoch, or protected same-owner dispatch, exactly equal to transition.owner. A driver, administrator or caller cannot acquire this authority through principal spelling, an authority field, an arbitrary route, or supplied native flags. expected_generation selects the current issuer capsule; transition binds the independently fetched receiving owner epoch, proposal, current generation, current driver term and exact final transition. The receiver must be active or paused at the penultimate phase. The issuer is active or paused at that phase, or already completed at the terminal phase. Pending driver transfers may remain incomplete and peers may have different driver terms; the proof binds the receiver's term and each issuer's exact generation without transferring driver authority. Recovery custody must be committed and preparation agreement complete. Every required accepted child has a successful known outcome and its complete result bytes are independently verified. All local resources, native material, current generations and continuing protection are verified before protected signing. No new child, intermediate phase, transfer completion, hold release or authority renewal is authorized. The request supplies no proof, peer authentication, key, expiry or native authority. Issuance does not mutate a workflow generation. Retain the exact request, original authenticated principal, signed complete result, original RecordReference and required native material before acknowledgement. The driver and native routes share the same issuer-owned attestation identity namespace. Exact replay requires current read scope and the same independently authenticated receiving owner epoch, then returns original custody before generation, lifecycle, driver, expiry or native checks; changed input is CONFLICT. Lost replies are acceptance uncertainty; retry exactly or use workflow.attestation.get and complete record.read. Every fresh native settlement independently checks each exact retained record through workflow.native-attestation.check and enrolled peer routing. Expiry never releases protection or frees an accepted identity. Refuse new capacity without evicting accepted requests or results. This bounded request carries no complete collection.

NativeAttestationCheckRequest.description: Protected peer check of one exact retained native-owner final-settlement attestation. The issuer independently authenticates the peer owner epoch exactly equal to the retained transition.owner and independently loads current issuer and receiver capsules, complete accepted successful outcomes, native material, resource generations and continuing protections. Current complete read scope and native check authority are required. This route rejects driver proofs; the driver check route rejects native-owner proofs. The receiver remains active or paused at the exact final source phase, generation and driver term; an issuer may already be terminal. Incomplete driver transfer is preserved, and recovery custody is committed. Check signed expiry against current time. Missing or stale native protection refuses; a caller-provided prior check or signed record is insufficient. Return the bounded CurrentAttestation without mutating bytes, renewing expiry, completing transfer, releasing holds or granting native authority. The receiver serializes final settlement under its own native exclusion; this observation is not a lease.
